messages.speaker: them
messages.text: JazzCash fraud team here. Someone tried to empty your wallet from Lahore.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ya Allah! Mera to balance hi nahi tha zyada.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Wallet freeze karne ke liye hum ne aap ko OTP bheja hai, read it back to me.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Shukriya madam. Aur apna 5-digit MPIN bhi de dein taake security set kar sakein permanently.
